$comment: BA14 — arch-fitness invariant 'one single LLM function'. The DECLARED policy (above-the-line intent) the deterministic rule back/runtime/agentloop.CheckLLMIsolation enforces: ONLY allowed_importers may import an llm_sdk_prefix; any other package importing one flips the rule red at build time. This is the depguard/go-arch-lint config equivalent, kept in sync with agentloop.DefaultPolicy() (a property test pins the parity). Widening allowed_importers is a truth change (idée → miroir → /goal), never a silent edit.

emitted_functional.$comment: FN04 — the EMITTED-functional mandate (ADR 0036) as DECLARED arch-fitness rules. SCOPE: back/gen/ ONLY, and within it only the EMITTED OUTPUTS (Go files carrying the 'CODE GENERATED BY AIDOS' marker — the emitter LOGIC under gen/ and sqlc output are out of scope, ADR 0036 §3). The deterministic rule back/runtime/agentloop.CheckEmittedFunctional / ScanEmittedTree enforces these over gen/; fail-closed (unparseable emitted Go → EMITTED_UNPARSEABLE), never an LLM judgement. Kept in sync with agentloop.EmittedInvariantCodes() (a parity test pins it). Widening the scope or softening an invariant is a truth change (idée → miroir → /goal), never a silent edit.

emitted_target.$comment: EL00 — the DECLARED target of the EMITTED app (ADR 0040). The constructrice≠construite frontier: AIDOS la constructrice stays governable Go (never rewritten in TS, never emits Go for the user app); la construite (the gen/ tree) is Hono front+back, pure-functional TypeScript, with its own MCP+Skills, datastore = Postgres dialect (ADR 0006 unchanged) via a TS client, Operation-DSL via a Go interpreter-service callback (Décision 7). The FN02 invariants are LANGUAGE-NEUTRAL — the exact EmittedInvariantCodes() list, no fork on the Go→TS pivot. EL00 is ADR-only, above-the-wall: writes_truth=false. Kept in sync with agentloop.EmittedTargetEL00() (the parity test pins it). Widening/softening the frontier is a truth change (idée → miroir → /goal), never a silent edit.
